clean_body: "This is going to be the biggest DOJ election observer effort in history."| | | | | | = | | | In a recent interview, Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon, the head of the Department of Justice’s (DOJ) Civil Rights Division, claimed she plans to deploy at least 1,000 federal “ observers ” across the country this November to watch election procedures in jurisdictions not yet disclosed by the federal government. Given Dhillon's history with elections and voting rights, whether these "observers " would be there to ensure eligible voters get to exercise their fundamental right to vote or if these "observers " would be there to suppress and question legitimate voters is an open question. Just to refresh everyone: Harmeet Dhillon is a longtime legal advisor to Donald Trump's campaigns and was one of the architects of his "stop the steal" legal strategy to contest the 2020 election results. She has led DOJ's efforts to obtain unredacted voter lists from states and threatened criminal prosecution of local election officials. Opponents of voting rights aren't stupid. They know the tide has turned against their suppressive policies, but they're going to use every tool they can think of to limit voters casting legitimate votes. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | = | | | It's also important to know that, under federal law, monitors and observers are two distinct and different types of poll watchers the federal government can deploy. As you can imagine, observers have a lot more power. Stemming from the Voting Rights Act (VRA), observers have explicit legal authority to enter polling places and closely watch election workers, voters and voting systems at all stages of the election process. Monitors cannot, and are subject to state laws for what they can do or see. Legally speaking, Dhillon only has the authority herself to deploy monitors, not observers. Her public comments are a troubling sign that the DOJ may use the more expansive powers of the Attorney General himself -- far beyond the scope of the department’s traditional monitoring program -- for the 1,000 "observers" Dhillon says they plan to deploy. Election deniers running the “biggest DOJ election observer effort in history” seems like a recipe for disaster and suppression. Just as I wrapped up my debate, my staff told me the good news: you helped us get so close to our fundraising goal while I was on stage!I can’t thank you enough – really. I have to tell you, Susan Collins gave the exact performance I had expected. Lies, false promises, and a whole lot of concern. And when I reminded her that today is the anniversary of her deciding vote to confirm Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court , and gave her the chance to explain the decision, she showed no regret whatsoever. Millions of women across the country lost their reproductive rights because of that vote. Peter, I’ll tell you the same thing that I just told thousands of undecided Mainers: I’m for Medicare-for-all, making billionaires pay their fair share and bringing down the cost of living. Susan Collins also told those undecided Mainers what she’s for: tax breaks for billionaires and continuing to vote with Donald Trump 96% of the time. subject: I just stepped off the debate stage
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR]
body:
Hi there, it’s
Jocelyn Benson.

I just stepped off the debate stage after going head-to-head with my
far-right opponent for the very first time. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/20158?amount=15&t=1001&akid=1955%2E181023%2ELxdQyv ]Tonight, the contrast was
clear, but what truly matters is how we start tomorrow. After tonight’s
performance, Republicans are going to be flooding this race to prop up
John James and drown us out. We can’t let them. Will you rush a
$15
donation tonight or whatever you can spare to help us meet this moment and
win this race?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/20158?t=1002&akid=1955%2E181023%2ELxdQyv ]Donate →

Tonight made one thing crystal clear: my opponent knows he
doesn’t have to beat our message — he just has to outspend it.

While I talked about cutting costs, raising wages, and ending the
corruption that’s rigged the economy against working families — my
opponent spent the entire night parroting Donald Trump’s dangerous agenda
and trying to distort my record.

My opponent isn’t running on his record of voting for the war in Iran six
times, endorsing tariffs that are drowning Michigan families, and cutting
Michiganders’ healthcare three times.

He’s hoping Trump’s endorsement and millions of dollars from billionaires

I want to take a minute to introduce you to Captain Mike Bouchard. Mike spent nearly ten years in the Army - the 82nd Airborne and the 101st. Last year he volunteered for a nine-month deployment to Iraq on twenty days' notice, moving security assistance to the partner forces fighting ISIS. He came home with a Bronze Star. His time in uniform is over. His fight for this country isn't. Right now there's a record low number of veterans serving in Congress. Mike is on a mission to change that. He's running in Michigan's 10th District because he believes this country runs better when the people making the decisions have had to sacrifice.. Career politicians talk about sacrifice. Veterans have done it. He's building a team on the ground here in Michigan, and he needs your help. I'll tell you something about the man I work for. He is the last person on earth who would send you this email. Ask him about his Bronze Star and he'll change the subject to his grandfather's thirty-three years at the GM plant in Warren. If everyone who reads this gives $100, we can send postcards to 100,000 targeted voters in the district and make a real impact.

Thank you for supporting the campaign!

** Full Survey Results Released
------------------------------------------------------------

Did you receive our summer survey https://jonnyutah4congress.com/sept-2026-survey-resultsin?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d6ce2c2592-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d6ce2c2592&mc_eid=UNIQID late August? We texted thousands of CD-04 residents and asked about the issues most important to them, how they view Representative Kennedy’s performance in Congress, and how they’re thinking about voting in November. We’ve been releasing snippets of our internal poll every week, and we’re excited to finally share the full report with you.

Check out the full report and pfd here (https://jonnyutah4congress.com/sept-2026-survey-results?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d6ce2c2592-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d6ce2c2592&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

When I step on the debate stage 24 hours from now, I don’t know exactly
what I’ll be asked. But I do know this:

We’ve made real progress together over the last four years: Ten tax cuts
to put more money in families’ pockets, free school breakfast for 1.7
million K-12 students, more good paying jobs created — just to name a few.

And Derek, it’s
made Donald Trump absolutely furious.

So he’s doing everything in his power to tip the scales in this election.
Because if we lose? Donald Trump’s allies will control every state-level
office in Pennsylvania.

If that happens, every one of Trump’s demands will be met — even if it
means overturning an entire election. Pennsylvania stopped Trump’s
election denial schemes in 2020, but there’s no telling what would happen
with my opponent in the Governor’s Office.

Derek, I am one
of just two Democratic Governors running for reelection in a state Trump
won. So we can’t treat this election like it’s already decided. Not when
Republicans swept every statewide office on the ballot less than two years
ago. [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15360?t=1001&akid=553%2E245147%2EZVZkZe ]So please: Chip in $5 or as much as you can
to make sure undecided voters hear from us after tomorrow night’s debate —
not my opponent and her Mar-a-Lago donors.

| | Hello Peter,
Thank you. Truly. Every conversation you've had with a neighbor, every door you've knocked, every dollar you've given has carried this campaign to where we are tonight: 28 days from Election Day, with early voting in Ohio now underway.
I've run for this seat every cycle since 2018, and I can tell you honestly that this race is different. The new district lines put more of our neighbors in Hamilton County inside OH-08, and we've already closed the margin by about 12 points since 2020.
We are running one of the most efficient campaigns in the country, about 36 cents per vote. That means your contribution goes further here than almost anywhere else.But the final four weeks are when campaigns are won or lost, and right now I need your help to keep four things running until the polls close on November 3:
1\. DIGITAL ADS. Our ads are reaching voters on the phones and screens they check every day, telling them about lowering costs for families who are doing everything right but still feel squeezed, and making sure data centers pay their own way instead of passing grid costs onto our electric bills. If we go dark now, our opponent fills the silence.
2\. TEXT BANKING. Our volunteers are ready to text tens of thousands of voters with early-voting reminders, polling locations, and a personal invitation to show up. The volunteers are free. The texting platform is not.
3\. POSTCARDS. A handwritten postcard from a neighbor is still one of the most trusted pieces of mail a voter receives. Our volunteers are writing them now, and every stack needs postage.
4\. POLLING PLACE SIGNS. On Election Day and at early-voting centers, the last thing a voter sees before casting a ballot matters. I want our name standing proudly at every polling location in Butler, Hamilton, Darke, Preble, and Miami counties.
Here is what your gift can do:
\- $10 sends about 250 get-out-the-vote texts\- $25 mails about 40 volunteer-written postcards\- $50 puts about 8 signs at polling places\- $100 delivers about 10,000 digital ad impressions\- $250 keeps a full day of voter contact running across all four
Will you chip in today to keep all four running through November 3?

This campaign has always belonged to the people of this district: working families, seniors protecting their Social Security and Medicare, small business owners, farmers, and young people who want a future worth staying for. Let's finish strong, together.

The fight over New Mexico's doctor shortage is on your ballot.
Rep. Nicole Chavez helped pass the malpractice reform doctors fought for. Now one of the lawyers who fought it hardest wants her seat.
[Plus, should New Mexico legislators get paid?](https://us.list-manage.com/1CJXKuOWcKm?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) And imagine getting fired for something you said when you were 15 years old!

| | 🩺 **WHY NEW MEXICO DOCTORS ARE LEAVING — AND THE LAWYER WHO WANTS NICOLE'S SEAT
**
Mark was just told it’d take 18 months to see a dermatologist! One local provider's malpractice insurance jumped from $4,000 to $14,000 a month. Guess which services they had to drop.
Then Rep. Nicole Chavez opponent mailed out a flyer about how hard it is to see a doctor. Wait until you hear who her law firm sues.
Nicole takes us inside the fight that got this reform passed, and explains why this one House seat matters to every patient in New Mexico.

🏛️ **SHOULD WE PAY LAWMAKERS $67,800 A YEAR? IT'S ON YOUR BALLOT**
Amendment 4 would give New Mexico legislators a salary for the first time.
Krysty says yes. Nicole, a sitting lawmaker, says no. Wait until you hear what she wants passed first.

Hey, it’s Sherrod. As I write this message, I’m reflecting on everything we’ve accomplished so far in this race. What we’re building in Ohio is truly special.

clean_body: This will only take 2 minutes.| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 30 days away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next Governor of Michigan. Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming election for Governor on November 3rd. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. Cash on hand: TX-GOV
🔴 Abbott — $17.3 million

Between now and then, the undecided voters who will decide this race are going to see a lot of Greg Abbott ads, _and I need to make sure they hear from us too._
If you've been meaning to give and haven't yet, now is the time. Gina

Regional Labor Brief
Your City's Job Market Is Not the Nation's — and the Gap Can Be Enormous
| |
---|---
National unemployment is a useful headline, but no one looks for work in the national economy. People look for work where they live, and local labor markets can differ by a factor of ten. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Wednesday that in August, unemployment rates were lower than a year earlier in 234 of 387 metropolitan areas, higher in 126 and unchanged in 27. Cleveland had the lowest rate, 1.8%, and El Centro, California, the highest, 21.9%. Payroll employment rose significantly over the year in 9 metro areas, fell in 5 and was essentially unchanged in 373. The Washington, D.C., area lost 66,000 jobs over the year, the largest decline. These numbers do not tell us which cities are thriving, where anyone should move, or what any worker's chances are. Metro estimates are model-based, are not seasonally adjusted, and many changes are too small to be statistically meaningful. The practical value is to read the national labor market as a mosaic. For employers, local conditions shape hiring. For households, they shape job security and bargaining power more than any national figure.
| 01 | How Metro Data Are Built
---|---
Metro unemployment rates come from the Local Area Unemployment Statistics program, which combines survey data with other sources in statistical models. These rates are not seasonally adjusted, so they are best compared with the same month a year earlier. The national rate on this basis was 4.3% in August. Payroll job counts come from a separate employer survey, and changes are reported only when statistically significant. Good interpretation begins with that caution: most metro areas showed no statistically significant change in jobs over the year.
| 02 | The Lowest and Highest Rates
---|---
Cleveland had the lowest unemployment rate at 1.8%, followed by Bismarck, North Dakota, at 2.0%. El Centro, California, had the highest at 21.9%, followed by Yuma, Arizona, at 19.0%. Both are agricultural areas with large seasonal swings. Twenty-seven areas had rates below 3.0%, and six had rates of at least 8.0%. Among the 56 largest metro areas, Cleveland was lowest and Fresno, California, highest at 7.8%.
| 03 | Most Areas Improved
---|---
Unemployment rates fell over the year in 234 metro areas and rose in 126. The largest declines were in Cleveland and Kokomo, Indiana, each down 1.8 percentage points. The largest increase was in Lake Havasu City-Kingman, Arizona, up 1.5 points. Within the largest metros, Miami's division had the lowest rate at 2.7%, while the Detroit-Dearborn-Livonia division had the highest at 6.9%. The broad improvement fits other signs of a labor market with low layoffs, even as hiring has slowed.
| 04 | Where Jobs Grew and Shrank
---|---
Houston added 44,700 jobs over the year, Minneapolis-St. Paul 27,800 and Charlotte 21,400. In percentage terms, Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, each grew 3.2%. The Washington, D.C., area lost 66,000 jobs, Portland, Oregon, 18,800 and Atlantic City, New Jersey, 5,800. Bloomington, Indiana, had the largest percentage decline, 5.9%.
| 05 | Why the Capital Region Stands Out
---|---
The Washington area's job loss is the largest of any metro. BLS does not attribute it, but it likely reflects reductions in federal employment and contracting since last year. State-level data released earlier showed the District of Columbia with the highest state unemployment rate and the only significant year-over-year job loss. Federal employment changes are geographically concentrated, so their effects are felt sharply in a few places. For workers and businesses in those areas, national averages understate local pressure.
| 06 | Why Local Markets Diverge
---|---
Industry mix drives much of the difference. Energy, health care, government, agriculture and technology each respond to different forces. Population growth and migration affect both job counts and unemployment rates. Seasonal industries, such as agriculture and tourism, can produce very high or very low rates depending on the month. Housing costs influence whether workers can move to where jobs are, which can keep local gaps from closing.
| 07 | What Workers and Employers Can Control
---|---
For employers, local unemployment and job growth shape recruiting difficulty and wage pressure more than national figures. Businesses operating in several metros face different labor conditions in each and benefit from local benchmarks. For workers, understanding the local market, including which industries are growing, can guide training and job searches. This is not advice to move or change jobs. Relocation involves housing, family and cost-of-living factors that statistics cannot capture.
| 08 | The Long Game
---|---
A month of metro data should not be turned into a grand theory about which cities are winning. Most changes were not statistically significant, and annual benchmarking will revise the estimates. The national September jobs report arrives Friday. September metro data follow October 28. For workers, the long game is building skills that travel across industries and local conditions. For employers, it is planning around the labor markets where they actually operate. National numbers are averages of very different places. The useful question is not what the national rate is. It is what the local market looks like, and how quickly it is changing.
| The Takeaway
---

Housing costs influence whether workers can move to where jobs are, which can keep local gaps from closing. | 07 | What Workers and Employers Can Control ---|--- For employers, local unemployment and job growth shape recruiting difficulty and wage pressure more than national figures. Businesses operating in several metros face different labor conditions in each and benefit from local benchmarks. For workers, understanding the local market, including which industries are growing, can guide training and job searches. This is not advice to move or change jobs. Relocation involves housing, family and cost-of-living factors that statistics cannot capture. | 08 | The Long Game ---|--- A month of metro data should not be turned into a grand theory about which cities are winning. Most changes were not statistically significant, and annual benchmarking will revise the estimates. The national September jobs report arrives Friday. September metro data follow October 28. For workers, the long game is building skills that travel across industries and local conditions. For employers, it is planning around the labor markets where they actually operate. National numbers are averages of very different places. The useful question is not what the national rate is. It is what the local market looks like, and how quickly it is changing. | The Takeaway | 1 | Unemployment fell over the year in 234 of 387 metro areas and rose in 126. ---|--- 2 | Rates ranged from 1.8% in Cleveland to 21.9% in El Centro, California, reflecting very different local economies. 3 | Houston, Minneapolis-St. Paul and Charlotte led job gains; the Washington, D.C., area lost the most jobs. 4 | Metro data are model-based, not seasonally adjusted, and most job changes were not statistically significant. 5 | Local conditions shape job security and hiring more than national averages. Stay patient, stay curious, T.C. name: Gina Hinojosa HQ
subject: He heavily outspent us, and we’re still tied
body:
We need your support more than ever.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, Greg Abbott's latest campaign finance numbers just came out. Take a look:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261007_1_numbers.7Cgb9f&refcode=em20261007-2346&amount=5&t=1&akid=2346%2E299639%2E7M7w-F)
Yes, he outraised us again, and he has more than four times as much cash as we do. But look at what he's done with all that money. Abbott has spent $141.3 million so far this year, including $74 million in the last three months alone. That's six times what we spent over the same stretch.
Think about that for a second. Abbott's team called a recent poll showing Gina ahead "garbage." **But you don't spend $141 million in nine months unless you're worried about losing.**
And he has reason to be. Four public polls in the last three weeks have shown Gina narrowly ahead. Before last month, Abbott had never trailed in a single public poll in any of his four campaigns for governor. **Texans are fed up with his record on property taxes and data centers, and it's showing.**
The funding behind these campaigns tells a lot of the story. Abbott's biggest checks over the last few months? $1 million apiece from billionaires like Jeff Yass and Kenneth Fisher. Ours came overwhelmingly from regular people: more than 136,000 donors giving an average of $53. Nearly three out of four of them had never given to Gina before.
We don't need huge checks from corporate executives to win this election. We just need to keep doing what's working: raising the resources we need to compete and communicating our message with the Texans who need to hear it.
Peter, early voting starts October 19. [**We have less than two weeks to make sure voters hear Gina's message before they head to the polls, and Abbott is going to spend every dollar he has left trying to drown it out. Will you help fuel this fight?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261007_1_numbers.nMfhmm&refcode=em20261007-2346&t=2&akid=2346%2E299639%2E7M7w-F)

Thank you,
Team Gina

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3381%2E259176%2Ehon8zH) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3381%2E259176%2Ehon8zH)_

Peter

Mistrust and suspicion of arbitrary authority has been central to our country’s story from the very beginning. But today, we are watching that legacy get thrown out the window.

Last month, I stood alongside dozens of our neighbors at a Lansing City Council meeting to speak out against Flock Safety cameras. These are AI-powered, automated license plate readers being deployed across the state to log our every movement.

I told the council what so many Mid-Michiganders are already thinking: **nobody should have access to a complete archive of our movement.** Not without a warrant, and certainly not without our consent.

Thanks to an impressive grassroots effort, the City Council listened and voted 7-1 to ask the city to end its contracts with this invasive technology. | [Split $22 >>]( https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17939?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.07_WLawrence-Flock_B1_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON&t=4&akid=3381%2E259176%2Ehon8zH)
---
In other states, these massive data dragnets have already been weaponized. They are being used by agents to pursue personal grievances against exes, and by prosecutors to target women seeking basic reproductive healthcare.

**If you want to know how quickly politicians will abuse this kind of power, look no further than my opponent, Tom Barrett.**

Earlier this year, a group of brave students at East Lansing High School—my alma mater—organized a peaceful walkout to protest the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

Instead of listening to their concerns, **Tom Barrett’s campaign filed a FOIA request seeking the personal emails of these high schoolers.** They were desperately trying to hunt for ‘wrongdoing’ and intimidate teenagers who dared to speak out.

If Barrett’s campaign is willing to target the private emails of local high schoolers for exercising their free speech, imagine what politicians like him will do with a 24/7 database of your daily movements.

When Barrett had a chance to stop Big Brother from spying on us, he chose the surveillance state.

In May, a bipartisan group of lawmakers introduced an amendment to block federal highway funding from being used for mass automated surveillance. Barrett sits on the committee that voted on it. He joined corporate lobbyists to vote NO, helping to kill the amendment and keep the surveillance dragnet alive.

I’m running for Congress to restore the rule of law and protect our constitutional rights. I believe in a simple, classic American slogan: Don't tread on me—and don’t spy on me, either.

name: Kylie Glatfelter
subject: Early Voting Starts Today — Let’s Show Up, Indiana!
body:
No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-o/)
# Elise Nieshalla: Early Voting Is Here, Indiana. Make Your Voice Heard!
Dear Friends,Today marks the first day of early voting in Indiana. Over the next several weeks, Hoosiers across our state will head to the polls and make an important choice about the leadership and direction of Indiana.As your State Comptroller, let's remind everyone that it's the Republican Party that turned our state around financially -- and we can't go back to Democrat leadership in the Statehouse. As a big Get-Out-The-Vote effort, I ask you to share the below video with your friends and neighbors and on social media -- it tells the compelling story of "Six Cents to Common Sense" and how the Democrats left Indiana in financial duress and how Republicans turned our state around to being a model of fiscal responsibility!The choices we make at the ballot box determine who will safeguard our tax dollars, ensure election integrity, stand up for our values, strengthen our communities and help keep Indiana a place where families and businesses can thrive.This year, we have an outstanding Republican Statewide Team joining me on the ticket -- Max Engling for Secretary of State and Daniel Elliott for State Treasurer. Along with our Republican candidates across Indiana, we are committed to responsible leadership, conservative principles and delivering results for Hoosiers.**Now, it's our job to go VOTE!** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-r/) [Watch Elise's video here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-y/) With the start of early voting, there's no reason to wait to make our voices heard. Let's pick a day, make a plan and encourage someone we know to join us at the polls.We need all committed to voting Republican to make sure to cast their ballots -- and we need to win over the 13% who are undecided voters! Vote early. Vote Republican. And let's keep Indiana moving forward and strong -- and while we're at it -- let's **Make America Like Indiana**! **Elise Nieshalla**
**Indiana State Comptroller** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-d/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-h/) | [Unsubscribe](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-u-fdttuky-hhlljjcji-b/)

| This is Speaker Mike Johnson. I don’t often reach out like this, but it’s absolutely necessary. I need you to take every word of this seriously.
Election Day is less than 30 days away, and America’s future could be decided by one of the few REAL toss-up races in America.

[](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._ChGZ2iDZM4lHXOPyEg)

In 2024, Gabe was the first Republican to flip a blue House seat in his state in over a DECADE. It was one of the CLOSEST races in America, and his victory was decided by less than 2,500 votes.**
**Gabe is the exact kind of patriot we need in Congress:**
**
* He served our country as an Army Black Hawk helicopter pilot in the Middle East.
* He protected his community as a police officer for over a decade.
* Today, he’s fighting for our conservative values in Congress.

**
**That's the kind of person we need fighting with us in Washington.**
**Gabe is a workhorse, not a show pony. He works day in and day out – one of his first actions after being sworn in was voting YES on the Laken Riley Act. Losing Gabe would be a disaster for our pro-Trump Majority.**
**That's exactly why Radical Democrats are spending MILLIONS against him to drown out his message.**
**They’ve made it their top goal to flip his seat and install another Socialist in his place.**
**His opponent, Manny Rutinel, is one of the MOST Radical Socialists in America.**
**
* He’s a Vegan who has called agriculture “horrific” and “exploitative”.

* He protested shirtless in the streets against eating meat.

* Was caught campaigning with Zohran Mamdani.

* He was arrested for running onto a football field during the game to protest oil and gas.

* He even sponsored legislation to force taxpayers to pay for transgender surgeries for minors.

**
**And that's only scratching the surface...**
**Socialists like Manny Rutinel are rising up across the country and are doing everything they can to force their radical agenda into every zip code in America.**
**We must do everything we can to protect our Conservative House Majority and STOP this socialist takeover dead in its tracks.
[ That’s why I’m personally asking you to stand with Gabe Evans today and help him win one of the MOST important House races in America.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.)

Without your help, we risk socialists seizing power, erasing our Majority, and demolishing the MAGA Agenda to ruins.
[For every minute we wait, Democrats are only getting closer to victory and silencing Gabe’s campaign. I’m counting on you to step up when I need you the most.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.-cpzF4pOBV5ae9etQRg4Kg)

| [HELP GABE WIN](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.-2Ihak6ew)
---
| [SAVE OUR PRO-TRUMP MAJORITY](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.-uNwnQ)
---
To victory,
Speaker Mike Johnson

I’ve dedicated my entire life to service.
From flying Black Hawk helicopters in the Middle East to serving my community as a police officer.
I have and always will put serving my country and community first.
Now, I’m battling Democrats in my home state of Colorado to keep this battleground seat red! This race was one of the most expensive House races in 2024 – and I won by just a couple of thousand votes.

# "Crushed it!"..."Home Run!" - We Spoke for You, Maryland.
Friend,
We won the debate hands down! That's what observers have told me. Tune in tonight at 7pm to watch.

All of my attacks were on Wes Moore's policies. All of his attacks on me were ad hominem - at times downright ridiculous, including one moment when he lost his cool and said that he had only "invited me to debate to have a conversation, not lie..." but there were no lies. Every statement was valid and on his failed record.

Get your popcorn!

Two big deals we obtained for Maryland and America tonight:
1\. Wes Moore refused to promise not to raise taxes and fees.
2\. Wes Moore refused to promise to serve as Governor for his term, or promise not to run for president.

We proved our point - he doesn't have Maryland as his focus. He's left the state for 300 days of his term - nearly an entire year. We prosecuted your case tonight. Watch - we fought hard to speak for you.

Will you [chip in to help us win](https://us.list-manage.com/1BEGJcQUEvv?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)? We want to run TV ads with these clips and expand our latest TV purchase. [$176 for a 30 second ad; $1776 for 10 spots](https://us.list-manage.com/y0S6lx6T7sV?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).
Thank you. Let's win!

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Nominee for Governor of Maryland

## France Riots Grow as Arrests Pass 6,500
More than 250,000 people marched across France on Tuesday, the [biggest day yet](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMV3QeHA8pHBxG7rcdktk7CGZrIHItkB5-xX7Clsf6ZPO_3Uf716SrI__fmFX521c-SiJa-U8ztmvgbNstSxcipTZZz44pREB7UXDBWj0ocrOo_FNdDMzctew03TTnSVjr83TYU9gg9axN4b6EImtjZPvovX9NRA14k5PA5AGMKjbKdwMGOuxm64UNCoDHKVuuX1tstYnz-mz7ZzbsC1Ncs9a30V1_xQOCofjONppCuemcDjvKByS7KxwCMut48f7RR_4rk128X1ISlIsKQOPxUv6JesfS-wOfwIAAP__yStyWw) of a nearly three-week high school revolt. Riot police fired tear gas in Paris, Marseille, Rennes, and Strasbourg. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu told lawmakers 715 officers and 215 students have been injured, and [arrests have passed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQQOHT4C7WgDHEBcU27rLtltYED8lEGCIYxdrbr7JX-OsnfcX7c9tuyJnL4zceFCTVrdDZM4lQ21LDEqlxlX5Q79wTNjop582AcRcNF_AbRuEPbRaHPSQiQ9NAQftFT85bNw_PMLsU0emr32OcrJuXJab5Sg69i2bRMHD4ehrAawBr9HiPiwXr0Ez32UdtlAXaWWobX5WLPCnlv_VDbYz1GHJ4iry7mn4psyqznuc5vt61y7cqs3IRagWFa8GszIpNOGa6LBqu4IcW9vfJOXN3Xll4HMj5vys_3PEJ5l8AAAD__1mRdIE) 6,500, most of them minors. He accused Jean-Luc Melenchon's far-left party of seeking to "sow chaos" before next spring's presidential election, even as the Paris crowd greeted Melenchon with chants of "Melenchon President!" The revolt began in Seine-Saint-Denis, the district just north of Paris, where students say they are protesting teacher shortages, overcrowded classrooms, and crumbling schools. Immigrants make up [about 32% of the population](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnDAQRk9jOiMzeE22oEhD96dNiQYY705kbDSeXZTbR2yO8JejkZ6-935_zV_IifPjF-40aixzprMmUiWZo2BeSbho3alWrhGFTkppBgfBds66YcZV-U2zx2YbIxFQ39DYDfeuD4MPt-Y5er_86JfewS32_h5CDIO_hS0CQReXYWl4vHidc0PnnIeuXda7dz4g9MttWDsw3tHGWqT9Uzjrk2L6W94k7Vr2Jo1P1aOa_qeBycB0nmfL4C-PVt8GJsoGpus0MHFWkozKJWO6fi8pBxmYUHS1H1VbDyHcLK5SarX_I9goZbcHCldbX8tLlmpP1qdNKA-yvO_8EMxqj3K80odfGxm34-SUuIbBePfYkdNnsn6z9HuEfwEAAP__WWSXYQ) there, triple the national rate, and the same suburbs erupted in nationwide riots in 2005 and 2023. President Trump [responded Tuesday on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAQxvGngS7RMMYQFxQnndzlqpO2tCYwxKywsYAk2rdfZV9h2--TfsX_47pcKeW03__Rxq7Hsuz8apl757rESrvnmkpvG7eWWqTKL855QUBzUnACu5Dv6cmLJhlcZEYeJDtlJzUYq80oV2dDBLoEnJTXrMgYsjqMli8IJmqLMrm3pwCsAtCozjc_adCGcLiN1isUGjikXur5s6S9rxzzV3lyPfuyyezW3o8mhj8CZ4Fzr4--tuIT5ff_HjVUpvy37JTD__rYDoHzUVpvAmel7DBpM5pRD6OBSSlZXTheKefUjBUa7hulH0r2XxZ6OvwOAAD__yo_eLg): _"What's happening in France is nothing less than out of control mass migration. This isn't about schools, this is about Islam wanting to take over a once great Country!"_
## Car Loans Stretch to Record 84 Months
More than one in five new-car buyers are now [stretching their loans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpCAUBeCnwQ5zQRSnoNjGbrbd0lzxKmwQJnAzZt5-M_sKf3eSk3w5OX-e6xNjivn8jRc5Psqa6W6JmKmuR8XsqcbC7aLWYjuw0k0prRr0JBVIsCt6jm9aDXa7O4g0DR05ZR9qmKyZxi64GR7TPsM2jno-7GxmOwzbjv6wo1WApovu6ykAqwCMVv3mHwbMhHrYRuuVFgZoj1xq_7fEzIGO9Clvqr0vV5dcYH41MfwSehF6ue-793nz31Lo5UsLvSgQeoFv8lhlKpibxEryJOaYT5lKPqlKbPIqmUP6yBd-LsrcZIgsK_lSdxniGVof-EpddfvrjinFNllh4Lwwpv97-Ic3vp3-FwAA__-Ui4dZ) to a record seven years or longer, and the average monthly payment still climbed to an all-time high of $787 in the third quarter, according to new, third-quarter data. Buyers financed a record $44,664 on average, while the typical down payment [slipped to $5,554](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO3CAQBOCnsbs9YczBXUGRxt2fNqW1hrVNhMFZuEP39pEj5Qn-eqRvRvPra_7CEEPafuJBtq55TtRKpFqJ55UxOeKQazmolFBWZGoU4yyF1DAIEGZGV8ObZoW9tyuRpLEnO5jnMGqj9L3fLWmDRonHU3mtvHmuD6Olemi_jIvXeO-DvbxBCDMIoeRwW9xTCaVRjsvduEF2SpAPNfPtdw6p7rTGT34T31w--mj3Ws_SjT86OXVyaq3dyB-v5MuVd3I6mUrp5JSogUOGNSRMLqQNmFxmX-AMkeB1QkjwZwQssLw-xAWWzJwbHJkJMHkolam6HWLGVCDmtBEDugu5uJrhf_Nej9iz9WcLMYaiTafEdmCI_zbXb179tvJvAAAA__9KVJfH). One in five new-car buyers now commits to $1,000 or more a month. Interest rates haven't moved, with the average APR flat at 7%, but bigger balances over longer terms push lifetime interest to [nearly $10,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAUBOCnwR3R4cd2XFDcxl1uu6WF8SGwwpCFE1t5-1VW-wbbz3wazcdtudmYYr7_tzsa8mXJeLaERFgXX212WGOhtmNrsXlb8cSUFgly4AI4jIt1FA9ctO024xElqg6NGCehhlEPfReMANXDdZh8rwa3-l6tk0Q9Alytugq3dtG8PQEwCgAtxWV1kwY9WKnWfnRCMg24RSr18llipoA-vcqB9eLK3iUTiB6NqX9MzkzOvtTNPimUGun1TjA5v30mZwFMzhlP7mzl6_OFtfFGFckF3DiFmDNWTsFmjgdWHjP_Uvy33FWzPc6YUmzDyDTcdxvTzwL643GHkd8BAAD__2UXgYs) per loan. Meanwhile, the average price of a new car reached $50,089 in August, up 1.9% from a year earlier, according to [the latest data available](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFygzAQRU8jOhhpkREuVKShc9qUzCIvsBmBGGltkttn7Cuk__PfvPd1G2_IkfflEzfyMqdxp7NEEqE8zhn3QJmTlI1K4TJjppNiHEFDVxtdazdiEH7SaLG6-5kIqK3IG3c1bedsd6lW3zucXK-h1ZPpAyH2du5saxHma-uwq9i__ozWzmhtwTRTuFptO4R2urhgQFlNd5aUm-_Eu6w0x9_0pNyEtFXRryJHUe2HgkHBcJ5nE9IPPiTxHl4TBQPvhZdVioIBH8ujSP1WQDnqTEfKomCosr8fJ8fIpXPK6mVDjm-E_LPM08NfAAAA__9ttXiH) from auto-pricing company Kelley Blue Book.
## Televangelist Jim Bakker Dies at 86
Jim Bakker, the televangelist who [co-hosted](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp_G3rAAOxAPDF28pWtH6wKXmARMBDd28_ZV-gr__Emfzjl_busNYor7_TdkNBTKuuPZEhJhXUOF3WGNhVrG1mILUPHElFbJpWKCM65XcBQPXCfovQmIEscejdCzGJWe1KXfjJ45gkDnwPuLUFJYdZ2d5cLpeUQx99F8_wTnWnA-STFYN098UiBHe9FOyG7i6COVOjxK3GnDkD7lwDq4kvtkNqJX68ZfnVw6uZznOYTy9-vx3Tu5vFsnl0fMzMLziZW9KDGX3pYRJjxgv2OKjVjIlW3vZmH3jCDnDwvwQeYRPLuqvhr_OmNKsSndTfyeIab_APTDboeR_wIAAP__EtqEmg) [_The PTL Club_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp_G3rAAOxAPDF28pWtH6wKXmARMBDd28_ZV-gr__Emfzjl_busNYor7_TdkNBTKuuPZEhJhXUOF3WGNhVrG1mILUPHElFbJpWKCM65XcBQPXCfovQmIEscejdCzGJWe1KXfjJ45gkDnwPuLUFJYdZ2d5cLpeUQx99F8_wTnWnA-STFYN098UiBHe9FOyG7i6COVOjxK3GnDkD7lwDq4kvtkNqJX68ZfnVw6uZznOYTy9-vx3Tu5vFsnl0fMzMLziZW9KDGX3pYRJjxgv2OKjVjIlW3vZmH3jCDnDwvwQeYRPLuqvhr_OmNKsSndTfyeIab_APTDboeR_wIAAP__EtqEmg) with his first wife, Tammy Faye, and built an evangelical empire that drew up to 13 million nightly viewers, died Monday at age 86. The cause of death wasn't disclosed. Their empire [unraveled in 1987](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAUhZ8Gb1hwzU8yMHTxlq4dLcCX5CbYjoDa6ttX7it0O9KRztH3fd2mm6dM6_3TL-ha2qYVj5qxNSxTKn6NWGhrdcFaqSZf8MCcJxBguBRc2MnHRjtOynezS4iAQ4dO2qscjFVGdw8XdQKrpYqow0XOGgabwqxDFMEK4y8duXNPCmGlEApkH-JVCWU8DEHbKIEpgTO1rfTPjdb2wJR_th1LH7ely-7R2ruy4YPByGA8jqOPoZ4cZ89gPCOD8UkLD_71wsLfLfOYvwOfCSu_GAZjV9z8PihnqsYyJe6Lp_x30P7pZXfwGwAA__-fJHe9) when Bakker admitted to a sexual encounter with church secretary Jessica Hahn, who said he assaulted her, and stepped down. The Rev. Jerry Falwell took over, and Bakker never regained control. He was [convicted of fraud](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEO2yAURb_G3rDgQcAeGLp4S9eOFoZH8hJsIiC2-veVq_5BtyNd6ere8-u-3B0l2h8_3Ya2xbzseNaErWFZYnG7x0K51Q1rpRpdwRNTWoCDZoIzbhbnGx24KNcHGxEBZY9WmElIbZS-9U87jdwpMXk1Ss2DjHFawRvQq5cARpue7NUnODeCcwViWP2kuNIO5HozXkCnOAZquQyvTHt7Yky_84Fl8Hnrk3229qmd_NHB3MF8nuewr_76ceUdzBd2MH8r-0cv2tjq3m8srB3s42rLhVUsBwbWaEMWMBb3DbQ_WMwp5RNLZYGwslGz4nenuRi57IsNn5NSoqpNp_hjc5T-jmr_6fKw8CcAAP__h5qKSg) in 1989 and sentenced to 45 years in prison, a term later reduced to eight. Tammy Faye divorced him while he was incarcerated and died of colon cancer in 2007. Paroled in 1994 after about five years, Bakker [wrote the memoir _I Was Wrong_ ,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3ypCAQxU-DGVPQoo4BwSZms-mGFmKrPdOCBYzW3n7LvcI_e8Gv3tef1_hyxBTW325HW5Y4BrwyYymYxiW54DFRLHnHnCkvLuGFzCMoaKVWUnWj84VOHI2rZrsgAtYVWt31um470zbVZmuvpsmbqYd-mRxMvjdPbJvGNKrrvYaK7O2nleq0Ugb040aUaR3UU9N5DcIonKnE9HhHCmXDhf_GE9PDx71iu5VyZFH_EjAIGBIyrRTDNxz8XVecb0rAcA8TMNxRAgatBAy3eNMuJ_f5YJIFGU8XVmTKRV5bzChxPyih9JHZHRlnSUFm78LsWM6EWboin22V7HxcxEy57YRR6-6I_7crPzz1tPAvAAD__0YLjQs) resettled near Branson, Missouri, married Lori Graham in 1998, and launched _The Jim Bakker Show_ in 2003, still on the air at his death.

body:
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.
| | | |
---
Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.
---

Fellow Conservative: What's with liberals and our children? Every election cycle, Democrats tell us they're moderates. They talk about faith, decency, and "bringing people together." Then you look at the record, and you find the same thing again and again: when it comes to protecting kids, they look the other way. You've likely heard about **James Talarico** , the liberal candidate for U.S. Senate in Texas. He's a former seminarian who quotes Scripture on the campaign trail, but despite his attempts to wrap himself in Christianity, _**he voted against a bill to protect our children from sex-change surgeries, puberty blockers, and cross-sex hormones**_. So much for believing that we're all made in the image of God. Talarico even refused to oppose a bill banning sexual performances in front of minors, saying he didn't want any legislation to target the performers. He's more concerned about protecting drag queens than children in Texas. Now consider **Adam Hamilton** , the liberal candidate for U.S. Senate in Kansas. He's the founding pastor of one of the largest churches in America, and he wants Kansans to see him as a shepherd. But in November 2005, teenage boys at his church's sleep-away retreat reported that a man came into their cabin at night and touched them in their sleeping bags. A Kansas appeals court later found that camp leaders "were dismissive of their claims." The church ran its own internal review instead of calling the police. **_The next fall, the church sent the man back to the camp as a counselor._** The man was later convicted of sexual battery. Boys from Hamilton's church camp had to relive what happened to them on the witness stand. Hamilton now says he "absolutely" should have handled it differently.

Jesus warned us: _"Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves. Ye shall know them by their fruits" (Matthew 7:15–16)_. Both of these men wrap their politics in the language of faith. But we're told to judge by fruits, not words. And the fruit here is votes against protecting children and a church that failed the boys who came forward. Scripture is just as clear about how seriously God takes harm to children: "_It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones" (Luke 17:2)._ **There is a real spiritual battle over our children's innocence. It's being fought in classrooms, libraries, and doctors' offices. And it will be decided in the U.S. Senate.** If Talarico and Hamilton win, Democrats are one step closer to a Senate majority, which will block every effort to protect kids from radical gender ideology. These fake pastors will have succeeded in perverting our faith and using it to bring harm against our children. The election is now just days away. ## Firing Squad for Fort Hood Killer
President Trump has approved a U.S. Army [firing squad execution](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAUBODT4AzrgS3_BASbOOtNN7T4eTRPwtALdNtz-5HnCpOVVNKnUv177A9NkdLzrz5QtcvnPeFZI7aGZXeYElVfdLKBckJHWE996bBLkBMXwGHetW30wX3UnVMG3Co6VGJexTDDClMXlDGDnbw1yzCtM3p0k5FmHdyyLCMsBjtSNycAZiFAjEOvDU5eam89OicB2AjoqOXSt4ANL119_MofLL3NRxdVaO1V2fCHyY3J7TzP3iZj75LJ7baZ3AQwucGdWnkfL44X2nejnHgipyMPuurEPRVKT17_v7XjPpfGQ86uD-2IXVHudVKMVKeZjfA8NMWfAe23x32U_A4AAP__3UiEgQ) for Nidal Hasan, the former Army major who killed 13 people in the 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, the Pentagon said Monday evening. Hasan, an Army psychiatrist, walked into a Soldier Readiness Center on Nov. 5, 2009, shouted "_Allahu Akbar_ ," and opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun before a civilian [police sergeant shot him](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpSAUBOCnwQ5zQK_EgmIbu3_bLc0RDheyCC7wq_ftN-4rbDfJJF8m8-tr_cIQQ3r_xJ10u11eE101UmtUVkspheoKJuNDTmQD1Qtv9KsEOXEBHNSKpoWT1hE7qzews-hICzWLQcEMU-e1k0rY2b3GEed5ekkzG_Uy0hrYhk2Q6oJ-OAGghAAxDj1uNDmJzjiyVgKwEciGlkvfPDW6sbr4ySeV3uS9i9q3dlQ2_GByYXK5rqv_fbX7KZlcHpvJRQCTCzyple_94HgcJZ9UuSVsnm8f7kIJ6c3rn2-03OXSuM_Z8h1r5dXn3KjwFCxG7rFiYnLpirbHFWIMdVJshPeOIf7b1P73y1PLvwEAAP__USeKwA). A 2013 court-martial sentenced him to death. Hasan admitted at trial that he was the gunman, saying he fired to protect Islamic insurgents from U.S. forces. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth [recommended the firing squad](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvgzAUhH-N2UDPDrHD4KELW7p2RA_8HJ5kTGo7Mf33Ff0Lne6kk-5039d9uiMHjo9P3MiWw-9TpJoDlUJpchQjZ58wLivvkRxTrnjgOilQupXQgplwKfymqcfG2RncIBuy0gzyYmAA3axWOxr6q1EzyrlftNEKFXhzG8yNrgZvDduzTgIYKUH2lw5n0l6hXzw5pwBED-S47KkrKxU6MPvws78pdcu-NcGupTyzuHwINQo11lq7Zc7njzMXajztKewwtCtmjK3nxPHR5u8Xurak1_YUamySdc_KIXDWRvTw2JDD30b5L5u3Vb8BAAD__5EMets), and the Army secretary will set the time and place. No one has been executed under the military justice system since 1961, when Pvt. John Bennett was hanged at Fort Leavenworth. Hasan could [stall his execution for years](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u3CAQxJ8Gd5yAu_NHQZHG3T9tSmuPXY5VMDjA2c7bR47yBimmmZFGM78fX8sXcOT0_g4r2Xb6vCQ6aqTWqCxIKXH1BZILnBMhUz3ghLAYZXqplVTDAq7xTssDOrQvhZPuyOph0vdBTarvgjVOjU9EfJr70KM2Xo9-fDqDfsRp8mPH9qrTSg1aK_243-BFvTfgnSdEo5R4KEJuudxaoEYnVB9_553KzeW1iza0tlVx_ybMLMx8HMft5wnpCoWZrz_CzFuO3NhBlP8M2GQrn3WTsG0l71Sl58LpLeuvD6Ckk9yncU7S53KpyZAzyhpyblRkYoQoA1RIwsxdsbgdHCPXfhAP9V6B49917X-p7tb8CQAA___hUZFD) by appealing in civilian federal court.

## Dennis Franchione Dies at 75

Friend,

Parents send their kids to school to learn reading, writing, and math... not to receive anatomically explicit toys with removable body parts from school staff.

But that’s exactly what might be coming to Minnesota schools soon.

**Fox News reported that “MyGender Dolls” will be available to school counselors, educators, and clinicians this school year.**

These “trans” dolls were developed through the University of Minnesota’s Early Innovation Fund, under a program Gov. Tim Walz has championed and been personally honored for. _They ship with removable, swappable genitalia and are built for children**ages 4-10**_.

body:
It feels like every single day people are talking about John Fetterman.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=121%2E42639%2E0NEhfk)
Good morning, Willis.
Over the past few weeks, there's been a lot of speculation about whether or not I will run for the Senate seat in 2028 that John Fetterman currently holds.
It's getting to the point where I am being asked about it in almost every interview.
I get it. Believe me.
One day he's speaking at the Republican midterm convention. The next day news comes out about him skipping out on meeting with paralyzed veterans to go on Fox News. Then he joins Republicans to cast the deciding vote blocking an Iran War Powers resolution. Then he opens up a joint fundraising committee with Pennsylvania's Republican Senator.
It feels like every single day people are talking about John Fetterman.
It's a huge distraction while we are less than a month away from the most consequential midterm election in quite some time.
At stake is nothing less than whether or not we are going to take back the House and Senate and put a check on the most dangerous president in modern American history.
It's a distraction for me too - given all the questions I get about it and the news it generates. I have my own House race, and as the last Democrat in Pennsylvania who represents a battleground seat, I am taking that seriously.
So let me say this:
John Fetterman is not going to be a Senator after 2028.
Remember what he's done. File it away. And come back to it when this election is over.
But for now, it's important for all of us to do what we can to win in 2026. And I need your help in my race.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: re: Trump's comments about California
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Schiff for Senate
body:
| No president has the right to write off an American city.
---
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8022?amount=10&t=1&refcode=aschiff_email_100726_irancaRR&akid=10710%2E5257348%2E2ycwxS)
Derek, At a rally in Nebraska, Donald Trump shrugged at the idea of Iran attacking Los Angeles and San Diego. _“Let them take out Los Angeles,”_ he said. _“Let them take out San Diego.”_ I want you to take a moment and really let that sink in. **The President of the United States openly inviting a foreign adversary to take out two great American cities with millions of people living in them.** This is the same president who sent the National Guard and the Marines into Los Angeles, and now he's shrugging at the idea of our cities being destroyed, as if the people who live there were collateral damage. And sadly, we have seen reports that Iran has launched cyber attacks on some of our cities and their water infrastructure. So the idea that Iran might retaliate in some way, shape or form is not fanciful. It is serious. Once again, the president displays the same cavalier attitude about taking the country into war even after 19 service members have been killed, and the consequences for their families, some of whom are in California. Those are my constituents and your fellow Americans, and I will fight for every single one of them. I'm working every day to hold this president accountable. And to bring an end to this disastrous war. **But with a Democratic Senate majority, we could do so much more:** pass War Powers Resolutions, get the ground truth about the war, investigate the president and his corrupt enterprises, subpoena his administration, and demand answers under oath. **[I can't do this alone. name: The Turning Point USA Team
subject: What this says about this moment in America
body:
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**
---

Friend, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

Your support does far more than just send you a book...

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed.

And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives.

Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for.

He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly.

That's why your support matters.

It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. # Harris County Elections are a theatrical production with negotiated outcomes and DOES NOT represent the TRUE and verifiable authentic vote.
## Examine the vote "heat map" from the 2024 election above...
**and let it soak in for a few minutes.** _So, what you are telling me is that the concentration of citizens in the epicenter of business and commerce_ _Fortune 500 publicly traded, indexed and audited company employees_ _Some of the best decision makers and money makers_ Located in the center of the 4th largest city in the USA are blissfully ignorant and consistently voting for Democrat Socialism? The very people producing "Corporate America"...the highest wage earners that are making multi million and multi billion dollar decisions daily are the very ones voting to **raise their own taxes** and **interfere with their own business** and obstruct with **MORE regulatory**? **So, THESE same people want to have more red tape, give MORE of their personal money away and want MORE CRIME and homelessness and they WANT higher and HIGHER prices?** Really? Yeah...I don't believe it either. HOW can the very people that make the decisions on economic markets, earn the highest compensation suddenly REVERSE course and vote in favor of insane economic policy, vote FOR higher taxes on themselves and vote in favor or MORE regulatory red tape? Because, that is exactly what they want you to believe is happening over and Over and OVER again. The 2024 heat map of blue (democrat) and red (republican) voters makes zero sense to rational thinking people and is the biggest waving red flag of election fraud. I suggest to you to consider that your election results are the results of an orchestrated production and NOT the real actual vote cast by the citizens. There are election fraud lawsuits with the most glaring being the one before the Texas Supreme Court right now for Harris County NOT following election code law to PURGE the voter rolls by comparing it to the USPS change of address database each 30 days. Harris County has not performed this cleansing in over 5 years. Over 640,000 illegal names are illegally in that database and THAT is the "BANK" of illegal ballots they use to "MANUFACTURE ELECTIONS" in Harris County Texas. That's like hitting your thumb with a hammer, then raring back and striking it again...then, raring back and really letting it have it with a another smashing blow. We both know that is NOT what is happening here... What is happening is a big giant orchestrated rip off. **ONE:**
When 12,000+ Democrat workers are employed to "put on" an election in Harris County and you start checking their voting records and find decades of Democrat Primary Election Voting Participation in the workers producing your election, you might want to consider you're getting bamboozled. **TWO:**
When the Harris County District Attorneys NEVER invite the Statewide Elected Texas Attorney General Office in to investigate County Election Crimes for a decade, you might want to consider you've been played for a fool. **THREE:**
When the Texas Secretary of State is appointed by the Texas Governor and the chairs rotate with their resignation from appointed office after certifying one or two highly contested elections over and over and ALLOWING the same people accused of the cheat to perform their own audit, you might want to STOP and require your Sec of State be elected by the people of the state.
---
# Highest Priority: Sweeping Election Integrity Reform
---
My Fellow Texans,
I encourage you to consider that "Sweeping Election Integrity Reform" is our highest and most important priority. Consider Florida and the results once sweeping Election Integrity Reform was passed by their state legislators: ALL COUNTIES, less 2, flipped RED Here we sit in a Texas with 254 Counties whereby population concentrations in the big urban counties are extraordinarily swollen, many times with non-native Texas not reflecting our historical conservative values. Florida was facing the same level of infiltration corruption with miserable results. There are several key elements the business owners, top business executives and credentialed professionals of Texas ask for you to consider: 1) The Secretary of State that certifies the vote of each county MUST be elected by the people of Texas reporting only to the tax paying citizen voters like any other statewide elected official. 2) Election Fraud MUST be vigorously and zealously prosecuted by the State Attorney General's Office with Citizen Oversight in each County and the penalty must result in the banning of any convicted voting fraud from every possible benefit of being a citizen of Texas for life. Theft of vote is muzzling the voice and will of the people and a sentence of life in prison, hard labor and public notice of election fraudsters is our only reasonable choice in a civil society. All else is chaos. 3) The Secretary of State MUST keep a separate "check point" electronic and tokenized secure copy of each ballot cast whereby each voter sets the PIN code to verify his/her legal ballot is cast correctly in the SOS system. Each county may NOT certify an election that does not perfectly match that system. In this way, our individual votes will be kept private and our vote will be 3rd party validated instantly. 4) Mail in Ballot fraud at present has no audit trail and ballots are NOT tracked and traced when they are "re-voted" at the County Election Centers allowing for wholesale ballot manufacturing. This is the source of the Election Fraud Investigation opened by Texas State Attorney General Ken Paxton's office in March of 2026. No chain of custody from the US Postal Service exists for Texas Mail in Ballots. This mail in ballot situation must be standardized, auditable and a clear transparent system that submits entirely to item 3 above. 5) Voter rolls must be purged of voters MONTHLY that no longer meet the test of valid voters residing in the county at the address on file validated by the US Postal Registration Database. Harris County Texas alone has not cleansed its database of voters in years with over 600,000 illegal voters still on its rolls from which ballots are manufactured to throw elections as alleged by the people's lawsuit before Texas Supreme Court as we speak. County Officials that do NOT purge the voter database are NOT prosecuted and this much change at once. They must serve prison time for NOT securing our voter registration database. This must NOT be outsourced to foreign owned entities and must be done locally by the citizens of each county. 6) Open Primaries are a source of weakening our Republican Party Values as candidates are inserted into our elections not reflecting our RPT chosen agenda and crossover primary voting tragically disfigures our Primary Elections. At the same time, our primary elections in big blue counties are often entirely run by Democrat Election Centers. **This is insane.** We must control our brand and hold it entirely accountable to our RPT values elected by our members at Convention. NO election fraud can withstand such vigorous and strategic integrity measures. We encourage you to make election integrity job 1 so the people can believe in our elections.

In this way, our individual votes will be kept private and our vote will be 3rd party validated instantly. 4) Mail in Ballot fraud at present has no audit trail and ballots are NOT tracked and traced when they are "re-voted" at the County Election Centers allowing for wholesale ballot manufacturing. This is the source of the Election Fraud Investigation opened by Texas State Attorney General Ken Paxton's office in March of 2026. This mail in ballot situation must be standardized, auditable and a clear transparent system that submits entirely to item 3 above. 5) Voter rolls must be purged of voters MONTHLY that no longer meet the test of valid voters residing in the county at the address on file validated by the US Postal Registration Database. County Officials that do NOT purge the voter database are NOT prosecuted and this much change at once. They must serve prison time for NOT securing our voter registration database. This must NOT be outsourced to foreign owned entities and must be done locally by the citizens of each county. 6) Open Primaries are a source of weakening our Republican Party Values as candidates are inserted into our elections not reflecting our RPT chosen agenda and crossover primary voting tragically disfigures our Primary Elections. At the same time, our primary elections in big blue counties are often entirely run by Democrat Election Centers. This is insane. We must control our brand and hold it entirely accountable to our RPT values elected by our members at Convention. NO election fraud can withstand such vigorous and strategic integrity measures. | | Dear Fellow American, I wanted to reach out with a special gift for you from our team at Hillsdale College, the College that’s teaching America about the Constitution and liberty. Each year on Constitution Day, we commemorate September 17, 1787—the day the delegates to the Constitutional Convention signed the United States Constitution. And as America celebrates its 250th anniversary, I can think of no better time to return to the documents that have shaped our nation and secured the blessings of liberty for generations of Americans. That’s why... **[I want you to have your very own copy of the U.S. Constitution and Declaration of Independence FREE.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc-K3DAMh5_GuSXYcv7NIYdlMykDs9uWKfQYHMvJiDq2iZ0t8_YlZQrttVfpkz6k3_e38U2RJbe8q9V0FOOIHkelvYuJ0p7IO1SPheY0--3hR-BQ54LnvBmVTvRhxlJl2FUg2rnNTCeak5BNWbVldu9EeUJUTcUnUbenCttK1qIVAKgnU05TRt2xT3DeCOCSQ9FMUioEMasWAWrNSr4HVMkU5CKhidr7ELylRDoWflsy291TCpHJFwYDg4Hc7Is7WRtRWVMY3BkMwesfJuV_X8XkEM2yGpdePRomey6Ai3cOJVz7a_-5P59vDOo9rWP0-6YPJGw-BqMTueXZWg3SvjLZm1WRfRa1WoOixR0Tv8X_eJ-Md8m4xGR_-3J-vbxcP12Gb-PXJr_cbvmfp2Rbh-EnWUuxbljJl0NSaL9m6X-j-ujgVwAAAP__9WamLw)** The Constitution and Declaration of Independence are more than historical documents. They are among the greatest charters of human liberty ever created, and reading them firsthand can help us better understand why America is so great and so free. Unfortunately, many Americans today have never read the Constitution and do not understand the principles upon which our nation was founded. That’s why Hillsdale College remains committed to teaching these principles—and why I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read these important documents for yourself. This isn't a surprise to me. Having organized across Florida for decades, I know firsthand that working families are fed up. Across our state, everyday Floridians are feeling the crush of skyrocketing insurance premiums, soaring rent, and corporate price-gouging on essentials.
Meanwhile, our opponent, an unelected rubber stamp for billionaire donors, is deeply unpopular. A grand jury report has raised serious questions about whether she knew about a scheme that diverted public funds away from healthcare for impoverished children to pay for political advertisements.
We are taking our message directly to every corner of Florida, engaging communities that have been ignored for far too long. Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

Perhaps the single biggest shift in public opinion in my lifetime has been support for legalized marijuana.1
The idea that not only would there be legal weed, but also that you could buy it in clean, above-board retail shops is a crazy development from where the country was in 2000.2 A quarter-century ago, I truly think that only the hardcore stoners and hippies would've really believed that this was possible.
I've never had super hardened views on legalized pot.3 I [voted against the marijuana legalization amendment in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/1d8b905c-ce17-49e8-96e0-8e5f6943a25e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but that was more on technical grounds; I thought (and still think) that the amendment was poorly written.
Nonetheless, [like the vast majority of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/126f2299-8b26-41cf-9331-d337b6ba7188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),4 I agree that no one should be put in jail for smoking weed. In any event, that's a false narrative; [there were ](https://substack.com/redirect/6ead7bab-6176-4db9-bb93-8b4450938f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[never](https://substack.com/redirect/6ead7bab-6176-4db9-bb93-8b4450938f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ that many people in prison](https://substack.com/redirect/6ead7bab-6176-4db9-bb93-8b4450938f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for true marijuana-specific offenses to begin with, even though recreational weed is [still federally illegal](https://substack.com/redirect/c613562d-d0ab-44c1-a12b-810e68a24d04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But one thing that's been lost in the (largely settled) debate about legalizing weed: today's marijuana is nothing like the marijuana from a generation ago. Because of how marijuana has been grown and bred, **[today's weed is more than 15× stronger](https://substack.com/redirect/d036a397-ca34-4abb-9dab-f918750a887e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than it was back in 1977**, pre-legalization.
Arguments in favor of legalizing pot focus on a drug that isn't particularly strong and isn't particularly dangerous. As it gets stronger and more potent, that's not obviously true anymore. Regulators need to catch up.
> _**Article summary:**_
> * _Marijuana has become much more potent, even since states have legalized it._
> * _Yes, marijuana is addicting. Especially at high potencies, that 's a particular concern for teenagers and for daily users._
> * _The solution? The federal government should finally legalize it, because that would allow for better, more consistent regulation and consumer protection._

### [Puff, the Magic Dragon](https://substack.com/redirect/5fbc2638-c47a-4e7b-bed8-4f0eedcfdf73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's start with the math: weed is getting really, really powerful. This is a chart from the Drug Enforcement Administration:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d036a397-ca34-4abb-9dab-f918750a887e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Source: DEA, [2024 National Drug Threat Assessment](https://substack.com/redirect/d036a397-ca34-4abb-9dab-f918750a887e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Keep in mind that this is the _average_ ; there's a lot of pot out there that's even stronger. There are marijuana products where the [THC content is as high as 90%](https://substack.com/redirect/40b59ace-7599-4a66-b012-48d683803235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), especially with [newer offerings like vapes](https://substack.com/redirect/9a2120af-fc0e-4f1f-ae7b-ecccf1d9d4be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As more states move towards legalization--either full recreational legalization or medical legalization, which is [incredibly](https://substack.com/redirect/fc465eaf-e815-40a7-989e-1491925f5304?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [easy](https://substack.com/redirect/02b0d140-01fe-4bad-81c2-6c22c8a4627e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [to](https://substack.com/redirect/556e77c8-938e-4c94-ae06-7269370b63f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [game](https://substack.com/redirect/164be680-e066-46f9-a13e-dc62fe534383?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--[only a small number have limits on the potency of most marijuana products](https://substack.com/redirect/c0a43f58-3128-4148-9474-3fd4089ba7e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) being sold.5 Because this is regulated at the state level, how this is communicated to consumers varies considerably.6
The other thing that's alarming about this increase is that when people support legalization, as the nature of marijuana changes, it's not obvious that they really know what they're voting to legalize. A joint with low THC concentration is very different from a vape whose THC concentration might be 25× higher. Here's what I mean:
* [47% of Americans ages 12+ have consumed marijuana](https://substack.com/redirect/80b8043a-9490-4d03-b4c2-5576fc46e485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at some point in their lifetime, but only 21% have done so in the past year.
* That leaves 26% of Americans--some 75 million people7--who have consumed marijuana, and who therefore think they understand what's being sold at the local vape shop, without necessarily understanding how much more potent it's become.

### [We Be Burnin'](https://substack.com/redirect/79fc495b-79b8-45ed-b059-bb0d0cf4cb89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At the same time that marijuana is becoming way more potent, it's also becoming way more common. A few years ago, for the first time ever, the number of people who consume marijuana every day surpassed the number who drink every day.8
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9b4b16c1-b4f1-4dfd-b122-fab965101929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Source: [Axios](https://substack.com/redirect/9b4b16c1-b4f1-4dfd-b122-fab965101929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've brought this up before in the [context of online sports gambling](https://substack.com/redirect/59fc8618-bcde-452d-b072-65b4c52f4241?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) too: when you legalize something, more people are going to do it. Yes, plenty of people partake in all sorts of illegal activities, but a lot of people don't really want to break the law.
That's backed up by the data here: adults in states where marijuana is legal [consume it 20% more frequently](https://substack.com/redirect/aea75191-a941-4f14-8f89-85cf1826cd2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than in states where it's not.9
The other evidence comes from global marijuana consumption. It turns out that North America is unusual in having legalized weed; in [most of the world, it's illegal](https://substack.com/redirect/03406aa5-8e03-4224-844e-2339920152e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The consequences of that are borne out in the data, where North America's rates of marijuana consumption are by far the highest in the world:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de29ea9f-38b7-4a0a-8ef1-a52fa5793112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
